Hoisting it above looks correct and is a silent no-op, since every `registry.get_entry()` returns `None` against an empty registry.

**The exemption has to be per-kind.** Adapter registration is process-global while declarations are per-run, so by run two the adapter's own handler occupies the name — a bare "is this name registered?" test rejects every legitimate repeat run.
